scope: CPU-only review and isolated administrative fault injection for the local progress observer; not a scientific experiment.
context: Parent reported the previous watcher exited on an unhandled SSH TimeoutExpired. The repair adds retries for subprocess/OSError/JSON failures and transient preservation-status JSON reads; main GPU work continued independently.
review_findings: TimeoutExpired is covered by subprocess.SubprocessError, so an SSH timeout becomes progress_read_retry and proceeds to the next iteration.
Nonzero SSH exits remain connection_check_needed progress states instead of terminating the observer.
Malformed or temporarily unreadable preservation-status JSON becomes preservation_status_read_retry, allowing subsequent reads to recover.
Successful later progress replaces progress_latest.json and appends to progress_history.jsonl with a fresh observed_at timestamp.
The observer invokes only the existing read-only remote status probe; its change does not launch GPU work or control pod lifecycle.

interpretation: The tested timeout and transient JSON-write sequence recover correctly. No blocking observer-repair defect found; this does not guarantee future SSH availability.
